info.description:
# DermaCare AI API

Backend source is authoritative. Import the companion environment, start with real role-specific credentials, and execute dependent requests only after captured IDs exist. OTP values are placeholders until replaced with the real emailed code; codes expire, are single-use, and resend is rate-limited. SMTP/Gmail delivery must be configured.

Doctor applicants register with role DOCTOR but remain USER until an active Admin reviews uploaded private documents and approves them. Re-login after approval to obtain a DOCTOR token. One login request stores the returned access token only in the matching role variable, while authToken tracks the currently signed-in account.

Stripe Checkout creation only returns a redirect URL. Payment/order/appointment/payout confirmation requires the signed webhook. Use Stripe test mode and Stripe CLI forwarding; the Doctor payout flow is a demo settlement and does not transfer money to a Doctor bank account. Demo direct-payment requests remain disabled unless ALLOW_DEMO_PAYMENTS=true outside production.

Uploads use multipart field image, accept JPEG/PNG only, and are limited to 10 MB. Doctor document downloads are private binary streams. Empty optional query parameters must be omitted rather than sent as empty strings. Saved response examples are structural examples with dynamic database records intentionally omitted.
